Firebase setup checklist
  1. Create a Firebase project and register a Web app.
  2. Enable Authentication → Sign-in method → Google.
  3. Create a Cloud Firestore database.
  4. Add your GitHub Pages hostname under Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains.
  5. Paste the Web app config above and sign in with Google.
  6. Publish the Firestore security rules from the README before using cloud sync.
